item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

item.title: Godrej Aerospace and the Backbone of India's Propulsion Engine
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
For 40 years, Godrej Aerospace has quietly forged the critical components powering India's ascent in space and flight. As global leaders eye Indian manufacturing, how is private industry reshaping sovereign defense capabilities? Read our strategic analysis.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Delegates from the 27th ISABE Conference toured manufacturing facilities, validating India's growing capacity in complex airbreathing propulsion systems. item.title: IAF Presses Industry for Autonomous Drone Dominance
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The Indian Air Force is betting big on autonomy. At a high-stakes New Delhi outreach, IAF laid out its blueprint for indigenous drones, forcing MSMEs and startups to step up or miss the defense transition.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The strategy prioritizes layered, networked drone families to complement crewed combat aircraft across contested borders. [SPLIT] ⚡ Critical technological bottlenecks include indigenous propulsion units, autonomous edge-computing software, and jamming-resistant navigation. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/iaf-presses-industry-for-autonomous-drone-dominance-693367.html

item.title: India Issues Urgent Security Advisory for Citizens Across France Amid Unrest
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
With over 2,400 arrests and violent clashes spreading across Paris, Marseille, and Lyon, the Indian Embassy has issued a strict advisory for citizens in France to avoid large gatherings and monitor local transit updates.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Protests originating from student grievances over overcrowded schools have expanded into widespread anti-government demonstrations driven by inflation and living costs. [SPLIT] ⚡ Localized curfews and public gathering restrictions have been enforced in major cities including Paris, Lyon, Lille, Nice, and Marseille. item.title: The Enterprise Software Tax: Billions Burned on Unwanted Upgrades
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Major enterprise firms are flushing 28% of their software budgets down the drain on unwanted vendor upgrades—and their own IT chiefs know it's making them worse off. Here is how vendor lock-in is quietly kneecapping global business.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Ninety-five percent of CIOs report purchasing vendor-driven changes within the past three years that they believed would reduce system performance or value. [SPLIT] ⚡ Seventy-six percent of IT leaders state they possess virtually zero leverage in contract negotiations against dominant software conglomerates. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/the-enterprise-software-tax-billions-burned-on-unwanted-upgrades-660396.html

item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ The purported PHP2Shell exploit enables unauthenticated remote code execution on targeted webservers. [SPLIT] ⚡ Security firms warn that mass automated exploitation will likely commence within minutes of patch publication. item.title: Federal Judge Dismisses Childhood Abuse Lawsuit Against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A federal judge has officially dismissed the lawsuit filed against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman by his sister, closing a deeply personal legal battle.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The dismissal was triggered by the plaintiff's failure to appear for a mandated independent medical examination and missed legal deadlines. item.title: Google Deploys Personal Intelligence to the Automotive Cockpit
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Google's Gemini AI is stepping off your phone and into your dashboard. With new Personal Intelligence integration, your car can now pull flight data from Gmail and navigate using your personal photo library.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Drivers can execute complex voice commands such as fetching flight status from email confirmations or navigating to locations extracted from personal photos. [SPLIT] ⚡ Major automotive partners including Ford, GM, Honda, Nissan, Volvo, and Polestar are integrating native Google vehicle architectures. item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh

Netflix is slashing its workforce, losing key executives, and facing a 20% drop in US/Canada downloads. Can co-CEO Ted Sarandos turn the streaming giant around with live programming?

item.title: US Bans Chinese AI DeepSeek Across Civilian Government IT Systems
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Washington draws a hard line on artificial intelligence. The US Department of Homeland Security has officially ordered the removal and procurement ban of China's DeepSeek across all civilian IT systems, citing severe data transfer and espionage risks.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The directive mandates the immediate removal of DeepSeek products and third-party services leveraging the model from all civilian federal networks. [SPLIT] ⚡ Federal agencies were previously instructed via a July memo to aggressively monitor inbound and outbound traffic flows to isolate DeepSeek signatures. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/us-bans-chinese-ai-deepseek-across-civilian-government-it-systems-520604.html

item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

item.title: Autonomous Swarms: The AI Agent Breaches Reshaping Cyber Defense
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
An anonymous hacker used an army of autonomous AI agents to breach over 100 enterprise websites, including industrial giants like John Deere and Cummins. We examine the operational reality of automated cyber warfare.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Targeted industrial heavyweights included John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins, though respective spokespersons reported varying degrees of containment and data exposure. [SPLIT] ⚡ The primary threat actor executed these sophisticated intrusion tactics using fewer than 100 Chinese characters of prompt direction, with successful breaches taking approximately 23 hours. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/autonomous-swarms-the-ai-agent-breaches-reshaping-cyber-defense-438882.html

item.title: Anthropic Breaks Ranks With Draft AI Law in US Capital
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Anthropic is breaking ranks with Silicon Valley's voluntary pledges, circulating a draft US federal bill that gives courts the power to block dangerous AI deployments. Here is what this means for global tech governance.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The proposal mandates frontier developers to conduct rigorous pre-deployment testing, public transparency reporting, independent evaluations, and robust security programs. [SPLIT] ⚡ The initiative disrupts Washington's reliance on voluntary industry pledges and executive orders designed to sustain the current economic AI boom. item.title: Marines Field Next-Gen Tech to Survive the Post-Golden Hour Battlefield
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The 'golden hour' of battlefield medicine is dead. Facing near-peer adversaries in the Pacific, the Marine Corps is fielding self-contained blood banks and ultrasounds to keep casualties alive during extended evacuation delays.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The Marine Corps has deployed the Expeditionary Medical Refrigeration Unit (EMRU) and MEQU mobile blood warmers to maintain forward cold-chain distribution without heavy generators. [SPLIT] ⚡ Point-of-care ultrasound systems like the KOSMOS are being integrated to rapidly detect internal bleeding on the battlefield. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/marines-field-next-gen-tech-to-survive-the-post-golden-hour-battlefield-225156.html

item.title: The Real Mission of the Army's New Drone Techs Is Constant Adaptation
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Forget the joystick jockey in a bunker. The U.S. Army's new 390A warrant officers aren't drone pilots—they're frontline software engineers and tactical innovators built for the electronic warfare age.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Training protocols are heavily informed by empirical lessons from drone-heavy conflicts in Ukraine, Nagorno-Karabakh, and the Middle East. item.title: Zero-Click Spyware Vectors Emerge Inside Programmatic Ad Networks
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

[SPLIT] ⚡ The AdFection campaign infected 45 iOS and Android devices at Al Jazeera between 2024 and 2025 using zero-click exploits requiring zero user interaction. [SPLIT] ⚡ Major tech platforms including Google, IAB Europe, and Beeswax have scrambled to revoke Discover-Tech's certified vendor status and platform access.
